messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: runtime-high-queue-depth on cluster/gpubox-12 (sev: high) — paging alex. link: https://alerts.redwood.example/incidents/2142500000 :rotating_light:

alex (oncall): acked. joining bridge now. looking at queue backlog and executor failures.

alex (oncall): initial mitigation: scaled runtime pool +2, enabled degraded-mode routing to fallback-model-v2 for non-critical tenants. running: ```kubectl -n runtime scale deployment/runtime-worker --replicas=18```

priya (sre): seeing sharp KV cache eviction spikes ~ 00:03 UTC in logs. looks correlated with a batch commit loop. grabbing heap dumps. `tail -n200 /var/log/runtime/worker.log | grep "evict"` shows repeated evict cycles.

marco (eng-lead): timeline? customer impact? we need a short blurb for statuspage ASAP.

jenna (support): affected customers: acct-334, acct-778, acct-990 (reports of slow responses & token timeouts). ticket numbers: #5532 #5533 #5535. customers reported around 00:05–00:20 UTC.

tom (cs): ok pls confirm scope — any enterprise customers in SSO/strict mode hit? I want to flag to AMs.

alex (oncall): enterprise SSO tenants saw elevated latencies but no full failures. majority of errors were 504 timeouts for long-prompt endpoints.

aisha (pm): action items: 1) get post-incident bridge summary + owners, 2) schedule postmortem within 48h, 3) customer comms draft within 24h. Who owns each?

priya (sre): I'll own root-cause investigation (memory/KV commit path). ETA first pass 24h. assigning: priya — investigate leak & hotfix PR.

alex (oncall): I'll own short-term runbook updates and mitigation docs. alex — update runbook and add degraded-mode checklist.

marco (eng-lead): I'll coordinate postmortem write-up & exec summary. marco — schedule postmortem meeting. propose: Thu 15:00 UTC (48h).

ops-bot: Bridge created https://meet.redwood.example/bridge/2142500000 — recording enabled.

jenna (support): I'll draft the initial status page blurb: "We experienced elevated inference latency impacting a subset of customers between 00:03–00:25 UTC. We mitigated by scaling workers and routing non-critical traffic to fallback model variants. Full investigation underway; preliminary fix applied. More updates within 24h." happy to post once you approve. :memo:

marco (eng-lead): small edit: include impacted accounts count (3) and that enterprise SSO saw latency but not complete outage. jenna — add that and send to statuspage @oncall for publish.

alex (oncall): mitigation looks stable — backlog drained, p95 latency back to baseline on primary pools. `curl -s https://metrics.redwood.example/api/latency?range=10m | jq .p95` -> 120ms now.

priya (sre): heap dump analysis attached to incident ticket. quick summary: memory spike in kv-cache when eviction loop triggered by repeated concurrent prefix writes. potential race in cache eviction metrics. suspect bug in commit batching code introduced in release 2024-11.

aisha (pm): good. For customer comms: propose two-step cadence — 1) initial status update within 2 hours (support), 2) detailed RCA to affected customers & AMs within 72 hours, and an exec summary to leadership. agree?

marco (eng-lead): agree. add: we will include mitigations & timeline + planned remediation ETA.

jenna (support): drafting initial note now. Copy for approvals: @marco @priya @alex.

priya (sre): remediation plan (short): 1) hotfix to avoid eviction storm (patch PR ready) — owner priya — target deploy in 24h; 2) add additional telemetry and guardrails to eviction loop — owner priya/alex — target 7 days; 3) long-term: audit commit batch logic and add concurrency tests — owner marco — target 21 days.

marco (eng-lead): assign owners in tracker: 
- R1: hotfix for eviction storm — priya — due 2024-04-05
- R2: telemetry & guardrails — alex/priya — due 2024-04-12
- R3: integration tests + audit — marco — due 2024-04-26
Please add JIRA IDs when created.

aisha (pm): schedule: postmortem Thu 2024-04-04 15:00 UTC (48h). add invite: @priya @alex @marco @jenna @tom. jenna please confirm if that works for AMs.

jenna (support): can do. I'll confirm with AMs; ask for any preferred window if not.

ops-bot: Statuspage updated draft saved: https://status.redwood.example/incident/2142500000/draft — awaiting approval.

alex (oncall): quick note for runbook: add `--degraded-mode` flag example and `kubectl scale` snippet, include rollback guidance if fallback increases cost.

priya (sre): linking quick logs excerpt: ```2024-04-02T00:03:12Z ERROR evict_loop: evicted 1024 keys in 12ms; concurrent commits: 8; heap: 4.2G -> 6.9G```

marco (eng-lead): postmortem owner: marco. priya please add evidence & timeline to the postmortem doc before meeting. alex add the runbook diffs. jenna attach customer-scope list. aisha will write exec summary after postmortem.

jenna (support): initial statuspage posted :white_check_mark: — link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/2142500000 — sent to impacted AMs and triaged tickets updated with note + next steps.

priya (sre): PR opened for hotfix: https://git.redwood.example/pr/4821 — tests: unit + simple load reproducer. requesting review from @marco.

marco (eng-lead): reviewing now. once merged, coordinate with alex for canary rollout.

alex (oncall): once hotfix merged I'll run canary on gpubox-3, then scale; monitoring for p95. plan rollback if errors spike > 1% of requests.

marco (eng-lead): agreed. final note: preliminary customer commitment — initial blurb posted; full RCA promised within 72h; remediation ETA (hotfix) targeted within 24h and longer roadmap in postmortem. we'll share a follow-up summary to affected customers after postmortem.

ops-bot: Incident 2142500000 status: mitigated -> monitoring. bridge closed at 01:20 UTC.

alex (oncall): closing loop for oncall shift handoff: handing to night team — @priya will take lead for RC investigation during handoff window. leaving runbook notes in incident ticket.

priya (sre): taking it from here. will post updates in this thread and in the postmortem doc.

marco (eng-lead): thanks team. follow-up checklist: postmortem scheduled, hotfix PR, statuspage sent, customer comms cadence agreed. We'll reconvene in postmortem. :handshake:
